title: Bubble Bobble
shortDescription: Bubble Bobble helps define a Game Boy Color platformer path in GameAtlas through a frozen catalog method and a direct Wikidata record.
highlights: Adds a clearly sourced platformer option to the Game Boy Color discovery path.
Links the catalog entry to a source record without presenting a rating.

signals.label: GameAtlas catalog method
signals.rationale: Indexed for the Game Boy Color platformer discovery path using a source-linked Wikidata item; this remains catalog organization rather than provider commentary.
